rationale: bugs_open/210: UpdatePageStatusAction stamps a page build_status='deployed' (plus deployed_at and built_from_plan_version=<current plan>) after an assembly SKIP, because its guards (pageHasComponents, pageSectionShortfall) are satisfied by the PREVIOUS build's output. The 208 fix refuses the stamp only for OWNED_PAGE_GUARD skips, deliberately filing the general case as 210 because widening is a fleet retry-behaviour change. This submission is that widening, WITH the retry bound the 210 file demanded: refuse the stamp on ANY assembly skip, flip to needs_rebuild (the honest state, same statement the sibling guards use), record every refusal in agent_error_log (the permanent counter 210's measurement section asks for — today the frequency is unmeasurable), and after 3 refusals since the last successful deploy park the page behind an OPEN page_build_failed work item (status='needs_human_review', no handler) whose item_key is the SHARED page-slot key 'needs_page:<name>', so idx_swi_dedup blocks every automatic producer (ReconcileSitePlanAction raw INSERT, WriteBuildItemsAction via insertWorkItem, tool-recreation) until a human closes it. A later successful deploy stamp auto-closes the park. Measured blast radius: exactly three live agents produce assembled_page (pageflow-builder, page-rebuild, site-work-orchestrator — config text-match, corroborated by LANDMINES.md:6019's nested jsonb_path_query walk); the six other agents running update_page_status never carry the key, so the widened guard cannot fire for them. The park insert is deliberately RAW SQL (emitOwnedPageReviewItem's pattern), NOT insertWorkItem: writeWorkItem's two-strike block counts the prior — dishonestly 'complete' — build items under the same key and would brand the park 'unresolved' at birth, i.e. terminal, so it would never hold the dedup slot and would bound nothing. Consumers told per owner ruling 2026-07-29 §3: feature_021 (bulk rebuild guarantee changes from silent-stamp to honest-requeue-then-park) and the mortgagecalculator tool-recreation lane (an open park blocks a needs_tool_recreation insert for the same page slot; insertWorkItem's false return reads as 'already covered'). The needs_page:<name> shared-key namespace + the new no-automated-consumer item type are registered in the concept register in the same commit (owner ruling 2026-08-02 §1 conditions).

plan.summary: Widen UpdatePageStatusAction's skip refusal from OWNED_PAGE_GUARD-only to any assembly skip; on refusal write an agent_error_log row (DEPLOY_STAMP_REFUSED_ON_SKIP), set needs_rebuild + NULL plan stamp, and on the third refusal since last success park the page behind an open page_build_failed item holding the shared needs_page:<name> dedup slot; auto-close the park on a successful deploy stamp; teach loadOpenPageItems the new type and align 'cancelled' with migration 157's closed set; update the two scope-pinning tests that were written to make exactly this widening a decision rather than a side effect.

edits.rationale: New sibling of owned_page_guard.go holding the refusal/strike/park/auto-close helpers, so UpdatePageStatusAction gains one call site, not forty lines, and the raw-insert requirement is stated once where it lives.
edits.sketch:
+const pageBuildFailedItemType = "page_build_failed"
+const deployStampRefusedErrorCode = "DEPLOY_STAMP_REFUSED_ON_SKIP"
+const pageBuildFailureStrikeLimit = 3
+
+// refuseDeployStampOnSkip is bugs_open/210's guard: the deploy stamp was requested
+// after an assembly skip, so the work the stamp asserts did not happen. It (1)
+// records the refusal in agent_error_log — the permanent counter 210's measurement
+// section asks for, written FIRST so a failed flip still leaves the trace; (2)
+// flips the page to needs_rebuild + NULL built_from_plan_version (same statement as
+// the sibling 0-component/shortfall guards); (3) counts refusals for this page
+// since its last successful deploy (7-day cap) and on the third parks the page
+// behind an OPEN page_build_failed item keyed 'needs_page:<name>' — the page-slot
+// key all three automatic producers share — so idx_swi_dedup stops the retry loop
+// until a human closes the item.
+func refuseDeployStampOnSkip(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, pageID uuid.UUID, skipReason string, logger *zap.Logger) map[string]interface{} {
+	var siteID uuid.UUID
+	var pageName, domain string
+	var deployedAt sql.NullTime
+	_ = db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT p.site_id, p.name, s.domain, p.deployed_at FROM pages p JOIN sites s ON s.id = p.site_id WHERE p.id = $1`, pageID).Scan(&siteID, &pageName, &domain, &deployedAt)
+	agenterrors.Write(ctx, db, logger, agenterrors.Entry{SiteID: siteID.String(), Domain: domain, AgentType: "update_page_status", Action: "update_page_status", ErrorMessage: "deploy stamp refused: assembly was skipped — " + skipReason, ErrorCode: deployStampRefusedErrorCode, Severity: "warning", Context: map[string]interface{}{"page_id": pageID.String(), "page_name": pageName, "skip_reason": skipReason}})
+	if err := execDB(ctx, db, `UPDATE pages SET build_status = 'needs_rebuild', built_from_plan_version = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1`, pageID); err != nil { logger.Error("refuseDeployStampOnSkip: needs_rebuild flip failed", zap.Error(err)) }
+	var strikes int
+	_ = db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM agent_error_log WHERE error_code = $1 AND context->>'page_id' = $2 AND occurred_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND ($3::timestamptz IS NULL OR occurred_at > $3)`, deployStampRefusedErrorCode, pageID.String(), deployedAt).Scan(&strikes)
+	if strikes >= pageBuildFailureStrikeLimit { parkPageBuildFailure(ctx, db, siteID, pageID, pageName, skipReason, strikes, logger) }
+	return map[string]interface{}{"updated": false, "page_id": pageID.String(), "build_status": "needs_rebuild", "skipped": true, "reason": "refused deploy stamp: assembly was skipped — " + skipReason, "refusals": strikes}
+}

edits.rationale: The park MUST be a raw insert: insertWorkItem's two-strike block counts the prior dishonestly-'complete' build items under needs_page:<name> and would brand this row 'unresolved' at birth — terminal, so it would not hold idx_swi_dedup's slot and would bound nothing. emitOwnedPageReviewItem is the sanctioned precedent for exactly this shape.

The widening itself. The owned-prefix branch stays first and unchanged (208's semantics: no status flip for owned pages — reconcile's owned_page_review protocol owns that state); every OTHER skip now refuses via the new guard. After a successful deployed stamp, auto-close any open park.

Two aligned changes: (a) the reconciler must SEE the park (type filter) or its skippedQueued counter lies while the bare ON CONFLICT silently drops its insert — the 091 dishonesty family; (b) 'cancelled' joins the closed set, matching migration 157's ruling that a cancelled row must not hold the dedup slot — today a human cancelling any needs_page-keyed item frees the planner path but wedges the reconciler path forever. 'unresolved' deliberately STAYS open/blocking here: freeing it would make the reconciler re-emit every two-strike-parked page through its raw INSERT (which has no two-strike), reintroducing the loop this fix closes.

edits.rationale: This test exists to make the widening a decision, not a side effect (its own comment says so). It becomes the refusal test: an ordinary content-failure skip now refuses the stamp, writes the error-log row, flips to needs_rebuild, and does NOT claim the OWNED prefix. Two new tests: strike-3 files the park (and the park insert is the raw statement, not insertWorkItem's), and a successful stamp closes an open park. Owner ruling 2026-08-02 §1 (CLAUDE.md): converging N producers onto one item_type/item_key needs no RFC provided the producer set and the shared item_key shape are stated in the concept register — done in the same commit; a work-item type with no automated consumer is not guarantee-changing vocabulary.
plan.risks: Fleet retry-behaviour change on the main build path, by design: pages that were silently stamped now go needs_rebuild and are retried up to 3 times (each retry is an LLM content generation — bugs_open/202's quota wall is a live source of deterministic failures, which is exactly why the bound exists), then park as needs_human_review items, a queue whose human surface is weak (bugs_open/033). An OPEN park blocks needs_tool_recreation/needs_content_page inserts for the same page slot and insertWorkItem's false return reads as 'already covered' (known landmine) — mitigated by auto-close on any successful deploy and by the item being visible; the tool-recreation lane is being told. The strike counter reads agent_error_log via context->>'page_id' (no index on context — the query filters error_code + 7-day occurred_at first; volume today is ~19k rows/month so a seq-scan-ish plan is acceptable, but a reviewer should confirm). agenterrors.Write is best-effort: a lost row undercounts strikes and grants at most one extra retry — fails toward retrying, never toward a false stamp. The loadOpenPageItems 'cancelled' change means the reconciler will again emit builds for pages whose needs_page-keyed items were cancelled — intended per migration 157, but it is a behaviour change for any operator who used cancel-as-mute; 'unresolved' stays blocking deliberately. The park's needs_rebuild state is subject to bugs_closed/037's open boundary (a replan may take a needs_rebuild page's composition) — unchanged by this fix, named so nobody rediscovers it.
